name: Free landholder
description: A free Saxon of middling means, holding a *Hof* of your own: a hall, a byre, a few fields and two men in your service. You owe your lord, Count Hathumar, tribute and service; you owe your neighbours peace.

traits.name: Strong of arm
traits.description: You have swung an axe since you could walk.

traits.name: Shrewd
traits.description: Men say you could sell a lame ox twice.

traits.name: Skilled hands
traits.description: Plough, loom or roof-beam: your work holds.

traits.name: God-fearing
traits.description: You were schooled a little by the monks, and it stayed with you.

traits.name: Well connected
traits.description: Your mother's kin sit close to the Count's table.
